title: P1AZ Inspector: where a decision goes
lede: You send one request. Mock answers from built-in rules; Live calls PingOne (cloud) or a PingAuthorize in Docker on your side.

nodes.label: This page
sub: You pick Mock or Live and press Send

nodes.label: P1AZ Inspector server
sub: Same request and answer shape for both engines

nodes.label: PingOne Authorize
sub: Policy tree returns decision and statements

nodes.label: PingAuthorize on-prem
sub: Docker on your side: policy decision URL, no token

steps.title: Mock (the default)
steps.what: You send Trust Framework parameters. The built-in rules decide, in the same shape as PingOne, and nothing leaves your machine.

steps.title: Live: PingOne cloud
steps.what: The server gets a worker token with your worker app (client credentials). The secret stays on the server and is never shown, then posts the parameters to the decision endpoint.

steps.title: Live: on-prem PingAuthorize
steps.what: The server posts the parameters to your PingAuthorize policy decision URL (in Docker on your side). No worker token and no secret are sent.
